# LZMA decoder

Unmodified C# decoder sources from Igor Pavlov's **LZMA SDK 26.03**.
Only the decoder and its shared dependencies are included.

Upstream: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.03/lzma2603.7z

The SDK is public domain. See the upstream license in `lzma-sdk.txt`.
The portable launcher compiles these files into its EXE; users do not need
7-Zip, Python, or an external decompression executable.
